releases.name: Marnie's Morpeko & Grimmsnarl ex Starter Set ex

description.text: Starter Set ex Marnie's Morpeko & Grimmsnarl ex, released on 21 February 2025 with Steven's Beldum & Metagross ex's: a ready-to-play 60-card deck of Marnie's Pokémon, Trainer's Pokémon having come into the Scarlet & Violet series the month before with the Battle Partners expansion. Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex's Punk Up attaches up to five basic Darkness Energy from the deck to Marnie's Pokémon when it evolves, and its Shadow Bullet does 180 damage and 30 to one of the opponent's Benched Pokémon. Marnie's Morpeko's Spiky Wheel grows stronger with each Darkness Energy on it, and the Spikemuth Gym Stadium lets each player take a Marnie's Pokémon from the deck once a turn. Each box held a full-illustration Marnie's Morpeko, sitting on a railing on a neon-lit street corner as Marnie watches over it, along with damage counters and markers, a coin, a paper playmat showing Marnie and a player's guide.
